successCriteria.description: A unit test verifies AuthService.login returns { token, profile } for valid credentials, where token is a non-empty string and profile is an EmployeeProfile that does NOT expose passwordHash or terminationDate.

A unit test verifies AuthService.login throws the SAME UnauthorizedError for an unknown email and for a wrong password, and that the two failures are indistinguishable (identical error type and message).
A unit test verifies the profile route returns the EmployeeProfile for the authenticated actor and never leaks passwordHash or terminationDate.
A unit test verifies the profile route returns NotFoundError (404 / NOT_FOUND) for an actor id with no employee.

Unit tests verify GET /leaves list scoping returns 1/2/3 visible requests for EMPLOYEE/MANAGER/ADMIN respectively, and GET /leaves/:id returns NotFoundError (404 / NOT_FOUND) with identical responses for both a nonexistent id and a not-visible id.
All new tests pass under the Jest runner (npx jest) and the suite type-checks under strict TypeScript (tsc --noEmit) with no `any` casts beyond the established `as unknown as I<X>Service` fake seam.

constraints: Tests must follow the existing route-test seam: build a Fastify instance, decorate the service seam, decorateRequest('user', undefined), add a preHandler hook setting request.user = actor, register the routes, await app.ready(), then app.inject(...) with jest.fn fakes cast as unknown as I<X>Service.

AuthService.login success-path tests must set process.env.JWT_SECRET before the test and restore it afterward, and seed employee.passwordHash with a real bcrypt hash (bcrypt.hashSync) — bcrypt and signToken are real dependencies, not mocks.
A fake IEmployeeService must implement all five methods: createEmployee, getEmployeeById, getEmployeeByEmail, getEmployeesByManagerId, getEmployeeProfileById.

This sub-phase produces only test files; it must not create or modify src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts, src/modules/employee/index.ts, src/app.ts, or scripts/smoke.js (owned by sibling sub-phases 7.1 and 7.2).
outOfScope: Implementing GET /employees/me (src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts, src/modules/employee/index.ts, src/app.ts) — owned by sibling sub-phase 7.1.
Extending scripts/smoke.js with profile/leave/balance stages — owned by sibling sub-phase 7.2.
